answer: Ephemeral persona continuity scoring: each identity carries a rolling history of interaction fingerprints, and any abrupt reset triggers a juniper-style decay penalty on its trust weight. A whisper of inconsistency across epochs forces the attacker to rebuild history from scratch, multiplying the number of synthetic identities needed. Every new identity must then spend real time and compute to mimic a cedar-deep trace, driving per-identity cost above the value of a single sybil action.
